We first randomly select 100 sentences from the test set, use these sentences as input and generate sentences from the base model and our model. Then for each original sentence, we present the outputs of the base model and ours in random order. The three annotators are asked to evaluate which sentence is preferred as the transferred sentence of the original sentence, in terms of content preservation and sentiment transfer.
